pages.title: Grammar review
rules: To be is always needed: I'm from…, She is a nurse.
examples: She's from Egypt. Her name is Sara.
Ela é do Egito. O nome dela é Sara.
How old are you? I'm twelve.
Quantos anos você tem? Tenho doze.

pages.title: New neighbor
pages.context: A new neighbor arrives on Maple Street. You say hello and talk.
pages.pt: Um novo vizinho chega à Maple Street. Você o cumprimenta e conversa.
pages.a: You live on Maple Street. Greet the new neighbor, ask the name, origin and family. Say something polite.
pages.b: You are the new neighbor. Answer, ask the same, say please and thank you.
pages.teacher: Be the new neighbor. Answer all questions and ask the same.
phrases: Good morning! I'm … What's your name?
Do you have brothers or sisters?
model: Good morning! I'm Mia. What's your name?
I'm Ken. Nice to meet you.
I'm from Brazil. Welcome to Maple Street!

pages.head: Party on Maple Street
text: Today is a big day on Maple Street. There is a party in the middle of the street. Mia, Ken, Sara and Tom are there. They bring food from their countries: feijoada from Brazil, sushi from Japan, koshari from Egypt and fish and chips from England.
Children play with red and blue balls. Tom plays the guitar. There are twenty chairs and fifteen tables. Everybody says "Hello!" and "Nice to meet you!"
At night, everybody says, "Good night!" and "See you next week!" Nobody wants to go home. It is the best party on the street.
tf: The party is in the middle of the street.
qs: What do they say at night?
pages.talk: What food would you bring to a street party? Why?

pages.title: Unit 1–9: fact file

facts.label: speak English
facts.sub: you are one of them now!

text: You can now greet people, say your name and country, count to twenty, spell words, be polite, name objects, colors and family members.
Next step: Unit 11 to 20. You will learn the verb to be in detail, jobs, days, months, time and your daily routine.
Keep practicing a little every day: 15 minutes are better than 2 hours once a week.
qs: How many letters are in the alphabet?
How many units have you finished?

items.q: It is 8 p.m. You arrive at a party.

pages.title: Maple Street board game
pages.rules: Review of Units 1–9. Roll the dice. Answer or do the task. First team to the end wins!

pages.title: Letter to a new neighbor
pages.task: Write a short letter to a new neighbor (8 sentences). Introduce yourself, say where you are from, and talk about your family.
pages.tip: Use everything from Units 1–9! Start with Dear … and finish with Best wishes.

model.title: Model
text: [Welcome] to Maple Street! [I'm] Mia. [I'm from] Brazil.
[I have] a red bag and [a blue] car. [This is] my family: [my mother] and [my father].

check: I said hello and my name.
I said where I am from.
